column1: # Shizen additions to the bundled dictionary, merged by scripts/build_jmdict.py after JMdict.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with # are comments. Rows with an empty glossary are skipped
# (leave them as a to-do list). Rows with the same expression + reading become senses of one entry.
#   glossary: senses separated by "; " like JMdict (first chunk is what the callout shows)
#   tags:     space-separated POS codes as in JMdict rows (n, v5r, adj-i, adj-na, exp, prt, ...)
#   score:    optional; default 1000. Higher wins when several entries share a reading.
# Generate starter rows from Settings → Dictionary coverage → Copy supplement rows.
